WITH valid_winners AS (
    SELECT maw.player_id
    FROM manager_award AS maw
    INNER JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = maw.player_id
), winner_hands AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN p.bats IS NULL OR TRIM(p.bats) = '' THEN '(blank/missing)' ELSE p.bats END AS hand
    FROM valid_winners AS vw
    INNER JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = vw.player_id
), hand_counts AS (
    SELECT hand, COUNT(*) AS winner_count
    FROM winner_hands
    GROUP BY hand
), total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS overall_total
    FROM winner_hands
)
SELECT hand_counts.hand,
       hand_counts.winner_count,
       CAST(hand_counts.winner_count AS REAL) / total.overall_total AS share_of_total
FROM hand_counts
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY hand_counts.hand
